<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="ce_bg" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.75">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#101820"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#080c12"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#03050a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ce_chrome" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eaf4f8"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#9fb6c2"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#5d707d"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c9dde6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="ce_iris" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="0.18" stop-color="#9fe8ff"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#1d6a86"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#06121a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="ce_glow" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <pattern id="ce_scan" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="4" height="1.6" fill="#000" opacity="0.28"/>
    </pattern>
    <clipPath id="ce_clip"><rect width="640" height="360"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#ce_clip)">
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ce_bg)"/>

    <!-- Rays, turning very slowly. Nothing here is in a hurry. -->
    <g opacity="0.13" stroke="#7fd8f0" stroke-width="1">
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 320 168" to="360 320 168" dur="240s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M320 168 L320 -60 M320 168 L548 168 M320 168 L320 396 M320 168 L92 168"/>
        <path d="M320 168 L481 7 M320 168 L481 329 M320 168 L159 329 M320 168 L159 7"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- The seal: the almond eye in chrome. -->
    <g transform="translate(320 168)">
      <path d="M-150 0 Q0 -92 150 0 Q0 92 -150 0 Z" fill="none" stroke="url(#ce_chrome)" stroke-width="5" filter="url(#ce_glow)"/>
      <path d="M-124 0 Q0 -74 124 0 Q0 74 -124 0 Z" fill="#04090e"/>
      <circle r="52" fill="url(#ce_iris)"/>
      <circle r="52" fill="none" stroke="#cfe9f4" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.5"/>
      <!-- Pupil: contracts once, slowly, on a long cycle. It's looking at you. -->
      <circle r="19" fill="#01060a">
        <animate attributeName="r" values="19;19;11;19" dur="11s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
      <circle cx="-17" cy="-18" r="7" fill="#eaf8ff" opacity="0.75"/>
      <g stroke="#8fd6ea" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.34" fill="none">
        <circle r="72"/><circle r="92"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <g text-anchor="middle" filter="url(#ce_glow)">
      <text x="320" y="292" fill="#dff1f8" font-size="30" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="13">THE CALM EYE</text>
    </g>
    <g text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="320" y="314" fill="#7fbdd2" font-size="9.5" letter-spacing="5.4">SUNDAY WORSHIP · THE ASCENDANT ORDER</text>
      <text x="320" y="338" fill="#4c6b78" font-size="8" letter-spacing="3">IT WAS ALWAYS WATCHING · IT IS NOT ANGRY</text>
    </g>

    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ce_scan)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="#000" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.06;0;0.03;0" dur="6.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
  </g>
</svg>
name: calm_eye_seal
